name: ki-cl-i18n
description: Ki.CL languages: a GraphQL subgraph that owns every translation, and a federated language switcher and i18next backend

scripts.development: yarn workspace @ki-cl/i18n run types; yarn workspace @ki-cl/i18n run dev
scripts.production: yarn build && NODE_ENV=production tsx --tsconfig Server/tsconfig.json Server/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @ki-cl/i18n run typecheck && yarn workspace @ki-cl/i18n-server run typecheck

author: Keni Lam
